method.name: Palu activation-aware head-wise low-rank K/V projection
method.port_boundary: The released wrapper targets Qwen2 rather than Qwen3.5. This bounded port preserves Palu's activation-covariance Cholesky transform, per-head SVD of W@S, inverse-S postmultiplication, and square-root singular-value factorization for Qwen3.5 layer-3 K/V projections. It does not port Palu's attention kernel, rank-search pipeline, quantized latent kernel, or all-layer model conversion.

input.selection: first 256 tokenizer tokens without special tokens

calibration.covariance: sum over calibration hidden rows of H^T H in FP32, explicitly symmetrized

comparisons: original Qwen3.5 K/V projection versus plain per-head SVD on held-out row 8
original Qwen3.5 K/V projection versus Palu activation-whitened per-head SVD on held-out row 8
authorized_claims: held-out selected-layer Qwen3.5 K/V projection sensitivity to plain and activation-aware Palu-style ranks
logical per-token latent-cache byte ratios at the selected ranks
whether activation-aware Palu projection appears complementary to CoMem's recurrent/document-state management at this bounded operator level
not_authorized: end-to-end LongBench quality or language-model logits
tokens per second, TTFT, or attention-kernel latency
all-layer rank selection or all-layer calibration
an implemented Palu attention kernel for Qwen3.5
